cases.name: Jamie Haggard
cases.relationship: Brother / stepbrother / partner or sibling's brother / brother-in-law
cases.narrative: On 5/10/2018, a roadside cleaning crew found her badly decomposed, burnt and dismembered remains in a suitcase by State Route 522 in Snohomish County, WA. Her skull was missing as well as portions of her limbs.
